minor.issue: trades[] projection at server.py line 2686-2687 omits 'flush_hold_at_pnl_pct' (and does not include it in the tuple). TokenDetailDialog's record-flush verdict line therefore renders as 'held from undefined% but price broke the floor' for flush-held trades. The /api/trades/history endpoint returns the field correctly — only token_detail drops it.

ui_bugs.issue: Verdict text shows 'held from undefined%' because token_detail API returns flush_hold_at_pnl_pct=null (see backend minor above). Fix is server-side projection; alternatively guard in flushVerdict.js when the value is null.

action_items: Add 'flush_hold_at_pnl_pct' (and consider 'flush_hold_floor_price') to the trades projection in server.py around line 2686 so TokenDetailDialog's record-flush verdict can render the hold-start PnL. OR null-guard the value in /app/frontend/src/lib/flushVerdict.js.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2686 trades projection is a hand-maintained whitelist — easy to drift from the schema (as seen here with flush_hold_at_pnl_pct). Consider either (a) using the same key list as HISTORY_OMIT inversely, or (b) adding a unit test that asserts every documented flush_* row field appears in the token_detail response for a seeded flush trade.

BotControlCard flush_dip_addon_input is a size-multiplier that doubles as the enable toggle: when the user types 0 the PUT sends flush_dip_addon_size_mult=0.0 (not reverting to the model default 1.0) alongside flush_dip_addon_enabled=false. Functionally fine (enabled=false short-circuits), but means the exported config can carry mult=0.0 which is a confusing audit value. Consider sending {enabled:false, size_mult:<previous>} or snapping mult to 1.0 when disabling.

rca of the issue: Backend root cause: `/api/token/{chain}/{mint}` builds `out['trades']` from a hand-written key tuple in server.py line 2686-2687. The tuple adds 'dip_forensics', 'flush_held', 'flush_addon_usd' but forgot to add 'flush_hold_at_pnl_pct'. The DB document has the field (confirmed via mongosh seed) and the parallel /api/trades/history path returns it correctly. Mitigation: add 'flush_hold_at_pnl_pct' (and ideally 'flush_hold_floor_price') to that projection tuple, or project the whole document and strip _id, keeping these projections in one place.
